Best food after 16 days in Vietnam
Oct 2026 • Solo
Having been in Sapa for four days already and tried the local dishes, I treated my self to Tim’s. 
My god, why didn’t I hit this place earlier?
My previous excursions to other eateries around town had proved hard work. The last three offering the entirely wrong dish I had ordered. 
To arrive at Tim’s, be greeted and looked after so well. I opted for the Pumkin soup and the Mountain Salmon and black rice. I have to say the flavours blew me away especially the salmon. Previous 12 days in Hanoi had not a scratch on this dish. Well done team, very well done chefs.
See you all tomorrow for something else from the menu!

Day 2 dinner at Sa Pa, Vietnam
Oct 2026 • Solo
Location is good as it is within the city center of Sapa, and the structure and design of both the interior and exterior is classic and appealing. The ambience inside is also a plus, it's like you entered a different place. The staff and servers are providing above and beyond quality service from the moment that you enter the restaurant, up to setting you up on the table, and ensuring that everything is well during your meal. The serving of the food is really generous, one meal can be shared with a companion. I order their green papaya salad with shrimp as a starter, and it was great and filling already. That's the reason why I wasn't able to finish my beef pho, my tummy is too full 😥. Their egg coffee is also great! Price is a bit high compared to the usual dining restaurants around, but you get what you paid for. Excellent customer service, quality food, and overall satisfying experience.
Read more
Written October 4, 2026
Mr .Tim
Dear Tour22489316461 

Thank you so much for taking the time to share such a detailed and thoughtful review of your experience at Tim’s Sa Pa Kitchen.

We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed our central location in Sapa, the classic design and unique atmosphere of the restaurant. We’re especially happy that our team made you feel well cared for from the moment you arrived until the end of your meal. Providing warm, attentive and genuine service is something we truly value.

It’s wonderful to know you enjoyed our Green Papaya Salad with Shrimp, Beef Pho and Egg Coffee. We completely understand about not being able to finish the pho — our portions are intentionally generous so our guests can enjoy a satisfying meal, and sharing is always welcome!

We also truly appreciate your comment about our pricing. At Tim’s Sa Pa Kitchen, we focus on bringing together quality ingredients, generous portions, Vietnamese flavors and attentive service to create an experience that feels worth remembering.

Thank you again for recommending us. We hope to welcome you back to Tim’s Sa Pa Kitchen in Sapa on your next visit and give you another wonderful dining experience.

Warm regards,
Tim’s Sa Pa Kitchen Team
